purpose: Controlled exploration-scale pilot within fixed static support; test learning, not a claimed optimizer repair.
checkpoint_selection: First saved checkpoint at/above 50k, within one full 2560-slot rollout; retain exact live counts.
capacity_control: Same 170-dimensional local input, architecture and parameter count. Initial tensors match except log_std; both arms receive real predictive inputs.
learning_control: Each run is evaluated against its own saved zero-experience policy; paired initial behavior must be identical.
primary_contrast: For every metric: (trained - own initial) with std 0.20 minus (trained - own initial) with std 0.05.
aggregation: One exploratory training seed. Report all paired-world effects; do not estimate across-seed variability or select only the better checkpoint.
resource_policy: One simulator worker per arm, sequential runs; existing coordinators remain untouched and combined local use stays at most five workers.
limitations: One training seed and twenty reused development worlds; no generalization claim.
Both heading and speed exploration standard deviations change together.
The optimizer review found most runs received almost all planned updates; this experiment does not assume KL early stopping caused the general failure.
Classical results are the preserved fixed Windows benchmark from an earlier evaluator revision; the causal exploration comparison uses one identical frozen source.
The cluster static-support bundle is unchanged and remains a separate three-seed 1M study.
Results do not replace the ongoing three-seed predictive-feature or support studies.
failure_behavior: Stop this coordinator on a failed check or incomplete budget, preserve every artifact, and do not restart automatically.
initial_control: All initial tensors must match except log_std. Deterministic initial behavior must match on paired evaluation worlds.
